an3.102:1.1: In early Pali, _nimitta_ is used for a feature or quality of the mind that, when focused on, promotes the growth of similar or related qualities. It has the sense of both a “feature” of the mind and a “causal basis” that gives rise to related qualities.
an3.102:1.5: This is because “pleasure” (_sukha_) is the proximate cause of immersion ([sn12.23:6.17]()). Thus without pleasure, the mind will never realize immersion.
